# Shantiban City

> Shantiban City is a gated residential plot community in Tapna, Baruipur, South 24 Parganas, West Bengal, about 20 km from Kolkata, developed by MRITYIKA REALTERS (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED (CIN U45500WB2019OPC230083, GSTIN 19AAMCM3987F1ZV). It has 220 plots; residential plots are 2.5 katha each and start from ₹20 lakh, plus 72,000 sq ft of commercial space. Plots are ready to register and take possession now, while shared infrastructure (wide roads, concrete drainage, electricity, park, community hall, shop spaces) is developed in phases. Site visits: +91 89743 32863.
